_meta.description: FacetSchema summarising a filtered experiment cohort's region distribution decorated with an OVERLAY_ZSCORE_VS_POP per-value standardised-distance overlay against the resolver-supplied population frequencies. Streamable FACET-host kind — sibling to OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_POP (10_facet_index_vs_pop.json): pair both together to get two parallel SERIES layers from a single Facet pass. Each entry's Statistic = (subset_freq - pop_freq) / sd_pop where sd_pop is the population SD across per-category frequencies. Renderers centre diverging colour ramps on baseline = 0 (mirrors the rest of the z-score family). pop_freq of zero emits PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO and skips the entry.
_meta.name: facet-zscore-vs-pop
